text:
The v2-marks proposal is clear, so I made no changes and sent nothing to its owner. `node Server/text-check.mjs` printed no flags for it. I judged the rest by reading the file, and I didn't shoot any page.

- **Ten seconds:** the title says what changes, and the Why section gives the point.
- **Asks and proof:** the asks are numbered, and a Proof section lists how each is checked.
- **Fence:** the fence names who owns which files.

I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I wrote the review to `v2-marks/review.md` with verdict: fix. The code change itself matches the brief, but the proof the brief asked for is missing.

- **Code:** `ChatV2.js` now reads `p.sent` and returns null when neither seat is set. The `prompt_of`/`sent_by_task` tracking and `reset()` are gone, and `ChatV3.js:163` uses `p.raw`.
- **Test:** the diff adds no marks test (no `marks.test.mjs`, nothing added to `ChatV2.test.mjs`).
- **Shots:** there is no `shots/` folder, so the 400 px and 1200 px shots are missing.
- **Evidence:** the task folder records no TestRunner result and no grep check. I saw no report to `mastermind-dictation-v3` either.
- **Readme:** I couldn't confirm the rest of `ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` is free of stale `prompt_of` or "step 3" wording. The diff edits only the first bullet and the "Try it" line.

I didn't run the tests or any grep on the new code. My `prompt_of`/`sent_by_task` grep hit the main tree, which doesn't have this change yet.

The review also notes two checks that came out fine and one open question. The fixture's `sent` lines now point at real message ids. `Prompt.sent` always returns an object, so reading `sent.fast` is safe. Nothing says whether step 3's text in `views-on-messages.md` is wrong, which the brief asked to hear either way.
